# gauge

Cross-repo format-conformance linter for the fleet. Zero dependencies (Python 3.10+ stdlib).

The oracle1 legacy study (2026-09-26) named this the fleet's most-missing
self-use tool: repos keep inventing shared formats (receipts, catalog
entries, tiles) and every consumer re-implements validation slightly
differently. gauge is the one implementation, enforced in CI.

## Built-in schemas

| schema | matches | enforces |
|--------|---------|----------|
| `receipt` | `*.receipt.json` | verdict enum, `one_of[signature, repro, chain_tip]`, `all_of[signature, signer]`, ledger/chain_tip patterns |
| `catalog-entry` | `catalog*.json` | id/title/kind, kind enum, id slug pattern |
| `tile` | `*.tile.json` | id/topic/generated_at, id slug pattern |

## Usage

```bash
python -m gauge check --schema receipt path/to/x.receipt.json
python -m gauge scan ./repo                 # find + validate every matching JSON
python -m gauge schemas                     # list known schemas
python -m gauge lint-schema my_schema.json  # validate a schema itself
```

Exit codes: `0` conformant, `1` violations found, `2` usage error.

## Repo-level schemas

Drop `.gauge.json` at a repo root:

```json
{"schema_files": ["schemas/*.json"]}
```

Repo schemas override built-ins of the same name. See `gauge/registry.py`
for the schema DSL (`required`, `types`, `enums`, `patterns`, `one_of`,
`all_of`, `item_schema`, `match.filename_regex`).

## Tests

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests
```
